case_control_rules.cases_not_named_treated: contrast_type case_vs_control_subject, without contrasts whose cases are named as treated (flag treated_disease_group, read from group names only; an unflagged group is not known to be untreated)
case_control_rules.control_tiers_1_2: control_tier tier_1_healthy_normal or tier_2_condition_negative_screened; hospital, comorbid, tissue and treated-case contrasts (Tier 3) set aside
case_control_rules.with_paired_tissue: contrast_type case_vs_control_subject or paired_tissue_autologous: tumour or lesional tissue against adjacent tissue of the same patients also counted
case_control_rules.with_comorbidity: contrast_type case_vs_control_subject or comorbidity_within_disease: comorbidity contrasts also counted

definitions.profile: one study/experiment/direction aggregate of curated signature taxa (human hosts)
definitions.feces: experiment body site exactly 'Feces'; multi-site labels such as 'Feces,Blood' or 'Oral cavity,Feces' are grouped with Other non-GI
definitions.condition: exact BugSigDB condition label of the experiment; condition_synonyms are counted only in the synonyms_merged sensitivity or with --condition-labels synonyms
definitions.disease_vs_healthy: contrast_class disease_vs_healthy and contrast_type case_vs_control_subject, with reversed experiments relabelled so dec means lower in the disease group; the condition_definition_* tables apply the other case_control_rules, and case_control_inventory lists the experiments in the three conditions that a rule sets aside
definitions.set: matrix taxa annotated with the trait in at least one feces decreased profile
definitions.annotation: a matrix taxon bears the trait when it or a descendant has the KG edge; has_direct_trait_edge marks the taxon's own edge
definitions.annotation_share: trait count / sum of all retained non-MediaDive trait counts in the profile
definitions.z: per-trait z-score of log1p(1000 * annotation share) over all 5,829 retained profiles
definitions.paired_delta: annotation share in the increased profile minus the decreased profile
definitions.down: the decreased signature has the larger annotation share (paired delta < 0)
definitions.study_collapsed: one vote per study: the sign of the mean paired delta over its experiments; study_majority_* columns use the majority of experiment signs instead
definitions.bh_q_within_table: Benjamini-Hochberg over every p-value in significant_results_summary.tsv

U6_size_matched.tolerance: each set size within max(2, 10% of observed)
